name: Implicit Span Characterization
description: Replaces explicit coordinate equations (y-x=p1, z-y=p2) defining contiguous intervals with an equivalent structural rule about the difference between the maximum and minimum elements across the two sets. This removes the algebraic equations that models pattern-match to deduce the `p1 + p2 > T` condition, forcing them to genuinely reason about the size of the required integer span.
